verdict.rationale: Sumsub is a KYC/identity-verification SaaS platform, not an AI agent; the evidence shows Sumsub built an MCP *server* so external AI agents can call Sumsub's tools (sumsub-docs-4, sumsub-probe-3), which is the opposite direction from this story asking whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Sumsub so it can consume their tools. There is no agentic core in Sumsub that would consume outside tools, making this axis a category mismatch rather than a gap.
